title: Full-Stack Development & AI Integration Trainer
description:
**Location: Chandigarh (On\-Site)** 




  





**Duration: 4 Months (Full\-Time Contract)** 




  





**Experience: 2\+ Years** 




  





**Joining: Immediate** 




  





**About Rabbitt AI** 




 Rabbitt AI is an AI\-focused company building practical, scalable, and future\-ready technology solutions for enterprises, institutions, and learners. From custom AI systems and Generative AI solutions to university skilling initiatives and workforce transformation programs, Rabbitt AI is committed to bridging the gap between industry needs and emerging talent.
 



 Through its learning and campus initiatives, the company works closely with institutions to help students become industry\-ready through hands\-on, application\-driven learning.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Rabbitt AI is looking for a skilled and passionate Full\-Stack Development \& AI Integration Trainer to lead an industry\-focused training program for university students in Chandigarh.
 



 This role is ideal for someone with strong hands\-on experience in full\-stack development, backend and frontend technologies, databases, APIs, and AI/ML integration who enjoys teaching, mentoring, and turning technical concepts into practical learning experiences.
 



  





 As a Trainer, you will conduct classroom sessions, hands\-on workshops, coding exercises, and project\-based learning. You will mentor students on real\-world application development and help them build practical, industry\-relevant technical skills.
 



  





**Key Technical Areas** 




  





 The trainer should have strong practical knowledge across:
 



 Full\-Stack Web Development
 



 Backend Development \& REST APIs
 



 Frontend Development \& Modern Web Frameworks
 



 SQL \& NoSQL Databases
 



 Authentication \& Application Security
 



 Application Scalability \& Performance
 



 AI/ML Model Integration \& Deployment
 



 Model Serving and Production Integration
 



 Docker, Kubernetes \& Deployment Workflows
 



 Git / GitHub
 



 Real\-world Software Development Practices
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Deliver engaging classroom sessions, workshops, coding exercises, and practical training
 



 Train students on full\-stack development and real\-world technology applications
 



 Conduct hands\-on sessions focused on building practical projects
 



 Guide students in developing and integrating real\-world applications
 



 Mentor students on technical assignments, assessments, and capstone projects
 



 Help learners understand industry best practices around development, security, scalability, performance, and deployment
 



 Guide students in integrating AI/ML capabilities into applications where required
 



 Conduct evaluations and provide regular feedback on student performance
 



 Track attendance, learning progress, and training outcomes
 



 Support students in developing practical, industry\-ready technical skills
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




 2\+ years of experience in full\-stack development, software development, technical training, or relevant industry implementation
 



 Strong hands\-on experience across both frontend and backend development
 



 Good understanding of APIs, databases, authentication, and application architecture
 



 Experience with modern web development frameworks and backend technologies
 



 Familiarity with AI/ML model integration and deployment
 



 Working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and version control
 



 Strong communication, presentation, and classroom management skills
 



 Ability to explain technical concepts in a simple and practical manner
 



 Passion for teaching, mentoring, and working with university students
 



 Prior experience conducting technical training, bootcamps, workshops, or university programs will be an added advantage
 



  





**Why Join This Opportunity?** 




 Opportunity to mentor and shape the next generation of technology talent
 



 Work on an industry\-focused university training initiative
 



 Get the opportunity to teach practical full\-stack development and AI integration
 



 Work closely with students on real\-world applications and projects
 



 Be part of a high\-impact program focused on hands\-on learning and industry readiness
